about: Types that the registered table of W3-b4 (docs/READING_SOUNDNESS.md 10D, K161) read and that were taken out again (K165, 'table change records' 1 and 2). The frozen rows of these types in tests/reading_soundness/ja_r10_w3b4.jsonl (entry_expect: read for 27 rows of P_CHANGE and 29 rows of P_CONSUME) are NOT rewritten: the tests and tools/run_rows.py read a row of a narrowed type as 'the entry refuses it, and the diagnosis says PLACEMENT_FRAME_NOT_READ:<type>' (a row that is refused before the type of the predicate is asked keeps its registered reason). Only narrowing is recorded here; nothing is widened.

P_CHANGE.name: HE_GOAL_OR_RESULT
P_CHANGE.reason: へ is goal (落ちる・広がる) or result (変わる: 工場から店へ変わった). The type of a result is not decided by the conventions (section 2) and a result takes PLACE too (店・都会・体育館), so goal/へ/PLACE is not disjoint from result: the table read a result as a goal.
P_CHANGE.source: review of round 1 (review.r1.md), F4, M1: 会社が工場から店へ変わった。 チームが広場から体育館へ変わった。 兄が田舎から都会へ変わった。 (live r7 and optimistic fake), 学校が校舎から仮校舎へ変わった。 (optimistic fake)

P_CONSUME.name: NI_TIME_OR_PURPOSE
P_CONSUME.reason: に+TIME is time or the purpose of using (金を休みに使う). A purpose has no role in the conventions and takes words of events and periods (休み・老後・正月), which are TIME too, so time/に/TIME is not disjoint from it.
P_CONSUME.source: review of round 1 (review.r1.md), F4, M2: 兄が休みに金を使った。 (optimistic fake: 休み direct TIME)
